brief.Text: Two-Time Maloney has a map I need, 2312 by 1984. Tell him I sent you, then put him down and bring me what he carries. {completequest XK0Z}

progress_maloney.Text: Tell Two-Time Maloney that I sent you for his map, then finish him. He is at 2312 by 1984.

turnin_note.Text: The other half is here, and this Shovel X-6000. Dig at 2446 by 1609 in the Valley. The turned snow is marked. {take PK0F}{completequest XK12}

need_note.Text: I still need the Ripped Note from Two-Time Maloney.

brief_shovel.Text: The shovel goes in at 2446 by 1609. Bring back whatever comes up.

turnin_tube.Text: The tube will do. Take this Finely Refined Notum and the Codex Divello. Danny Sawyer is south of here, 2510 by 915. {take PK0I}{completequest XK14}

need_tube.Text: I still need the Tube Container from 2446 by 1609.
